meta.title: KaaroViewer: An Immersive Cognitive Interface
meta.subtitle: Visualizing complex knowledge graphs and narratives in 3D

report_card.summary: KaaroViewer is an open-source, web-based 3D immersive visualization tool built on A-Frame and Three.js. It transforms raw text or Markdown documents into an 'Intelligence Brief'—a simultaneous presentation of a 3D factual graph, linear narrative arc, analytical insights, and structural metadata. It supports importing from structured JSON schemas and enriches them via external platforms like Wikidata.

story.title: The Need for Better Interfaces
story.narration: Modern intelligence and analysis require traversing dense webs of information. Reading linear documents is insufficient to grasp complex relationships and causal links. KaaroViewer was conceived to solve this by providing an immersive, spatial environment to explore knowledge.

story.title: Powering the Experience
story.narration: To render complex graphs in 3D within a web browser, the project relies on Three.js, wrapped within the A-Frame framework. This combination allows for WebXR capabilities, making the graph explorable in both standard browsers and VR headsets. The engine manages layout animations, force-directed graph relaxation, and node interaction.

story.title: Connecting the World
story.narration: A static graph is quickly outdated. KaaroViewer integrates deeply with Wikidata via SPARQL endpoints. It enriches local documents with real-world context, fetching images, descriptions, and linked entities automatically to provide a broader intelligence picture.

story.title: The Four Layers of Knowledge
story.narration: The true innovation of the platform is its JSON encoding structure. A single document is encoded into four simultaneous layers: the factual graph (nodes/edges), the narrative (story beats), the analytical (insights), and the structural (clusters/report card). The UI presents these side-by-side with the 3D canvas.

story.title: Beyond Data
story.narration: By moving beyond simple 2D dashboards, KaaroViewer transforms abstract data into a tangible, navigable space. It ultimately shifts the paradigm from reading reports to actively exploring knowledge landscapes.

insights.title: Spatial rendering dramatically improves structural data comprehension in complex domains
insights.body: By rendering nodes in a 3D space, users leverage spatial memory to remember where concepts are in relation to each other, improving recall and comprehension over flat text.

insights.title: Scalability remains a critical barrier for large uncurated knowledge sets
insights.body: As the number of nodes increases beyond a few hundred, the 3D space can become cluttered and unreadable, necessitating clustering algorithms and dynamic focus modes.
